Business Operations & Transformation Manager Job at Bluebulb Financials Limited




        
    

        
        Bluebulb Financials Limited is a financial technology company based in Lekki. Our mission is to simplify cross border payments for African businesses, allowing companies to make payments to global suppliers and receive payments from anywhere. We offer a range of solutions including treasury management, foreign exchange advisory, cross border payments, funds management, and investments.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Business Operations & Transformation Manager

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	The Business Operations & Transformation Manager will serve as the COO's execution partner, translating strategic priorities into coordinated programmes, measurable milestones and completed outcomes.
	The role builds the discipline needed to move the organisation from a person-dependent, manually coordinated business to a structured, scalable, technology-enabled institution; actively coordinating execution, closing operating gaps and ensuring every priority has a named owner, deadline and definition of done.


Your core mandates would be;


	Drive the organisation's transformation portfolio
	Strengthen executive execution and accountability
	Institutionalise critical processes, SOPs and decision rights
	Coordinate cross-functional delivery and resolve dependencies
	Provide the COO with accurate, concise, decision-ready operating information


Qualifications & Experience


	Bachelor's Degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Economics, Technology or a related field; relevant postgraduate degree or professional qualification is an advantage
	8-12 years of progressive experience, including significant time in banking, fintech, payments, consulting or another complex regulated environment
	Demonstrated delivery of cross-functional transformation, with strong programme/project management and process/operating-model design experience
	Experience working directly with executive leadership, with working familiarity with risk, internal controls and corporate governance


Skills & Competencies:


	Strong analytical and data skills (advanced Excel; SQL or BI tools such as Power BI/Tableau are a plus), plus process mapping and SOP design
	Ownership and relentless follow-through. Tracks commitments to verified completion without needing to be chase
	Executive presence to engage, challenge and influence senior leaders respectfully, with structured problem-solving and sound commercial judgment
	Clear, concise, decision-ready communication, integrity under pressure, and the ability to build genuine adoption of change not just documents.


Why Join Us


	 Deliver real, visible impact; your work will directly shape how the organisation operates and scales
	Be part of the team building “the operating system for global commerce” from the ground up
	Work closely with the COO and executive team, with genuine influence over strategic direction
	Comprehensive and competitive employee benefits.

title: Job Openings at Avocado Virtual Solutions
content:
Avocado Virtual Solutions (AVS) is a professional recruitment agency and business support service dedicated to helping entrepreneurs, small businesses, and busy professionals streamline their operations. We specialize in administrative support, customer service, social media management, recruitment assistance with onboarding, and business/company branding. Our mission is to help clients save time, enhance productivity, and build strong, recognizable brands while they focus on growing their businesses.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Sales Representative / Social Media Manager
     

            
    



Job Location: Kaura, Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Schedule: Monday – Friday | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Key Responsibilities


	Attend to walk-in and online customers.
	Drive sales and achieve monthly sales targets.
	Manage the company's social media platforms.
	Create and publish engaging content to promote products.
	Respond promptly to customer inquiries and convert leads into sales.
	Build and maintain strong customer relationships.
	Prepare daily sales reports.
	Assist with product displays and inventory updates.


Requirements


	Minimum of OND or equivalent.
	Experience in sales and social media management is an added advantage.
	Strong communication, negotiation, and customer service skills.
	Basic content creation skills using a smartphone.
	Familiarity with Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and WhatsApp Business.
	Must reside in or around Kaura, Abuja.


Benefits


	N80,000 monthly salary
	Transportation allowance
	Monday–Friday work schedule
	Career growth opportunities


Application Closing Date: 25th August, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Sales Representative / Social Media Manager" as the subject of the email.

 

2.) Personal Assistant / Content Creator (Lifestyle Brand)

Job Location: Wuse 2 Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time, Onsite
Working Days: Monday – Saturday

Role Summary


	We are looking for a highly organized, creative, and proactive Personal Assistant/Content Creator to support a lifestyle creator.
	This role goes beyond filming videos—you will be responsible for planning, researching, and creating engaging content around daily life, business, fashion, beauty, motherhood, and lifestyle. You’ll help turn everyday moments into content that grows our audience and strengthens our brand.


Key Responsibilities


	Plan and create engaging daily content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and other social media platforms.
	Research trending topics, viral formats, and fresh content ideas that align with the brand.
	Capture behind-the-scenes moments, daily activities, lifestyle, and business content.
	Assist with content planning, scripting, and scheduling.
	Edit short-form videos and ensure content is posted consistently.
	Help organize the creator’s daily schedule around content opportunities.
	Stay ahead of social media trends and recommend creative ways to increase engagement.
	Track content performance and suggest improvements based on analytics.
	Provide day-to-day personal assistance where required.


Requirements


	Experience creating content for lifestyle, beauty, fashion, or personal brands.
	Strong knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, and current social media trends.
	Excellent phone videography and basic video editing skills.
	Highly organized, proactive, and able to think creatively.
	Comfortable filming in public and directing content when needed.
	Must live within Abuja town for daily onsite work.
	Reliable, consistent, and able to work with minimal supervision.
	Must live within town; no Mararaba or Nyanya


This Role Is NOT for You If:


	You are camera-shy or uncomfortable creating content.
	You struggle to come up with creative ideas consistently.
	You need constant supervision or reminders to complete tasks.
	You are not passionate about social media, storytelling, and content creation.
	You do not live within Abuja town.


Salary
N120,000 monthly. 

Application Closing Date: 24th August, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Personal Assistant / Content Creator" as the subject of the email. 

 

 

3.) Social Media Manager

Job Location:  Remote
Employment Type: Full-time

Description


	We are looking for a creative, organized, and results-driven Social Media Manager.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the client's YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook accounts, creating engaging content, supporting daily YouTube Live sessions, and maintaining an active online community.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage and maintain the company's YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook accounts daily.
	Join and support the company's YouTube Live session every morning.
	Create, edit, and publish 7 content pieces daily, comprising:
	
		3 videos
		2 carousel posts
		1 storytelling post
		1 quote card, picture post, or text-based post
	
	
	Design engaging graphics and edit videos in line with the brand's identity.
	Write compelling captions, hashtags, and calls to action for all published content.
	Develop and maintain weekly and monthly content calendars.
	Schedule and publish content according to the approved posting plan.
	Respond promptly to customer inquiries and messages through the company's WhatsApp Community.
	Research social media trends and incorporate relevant ideas to improve engagement and reach.
	Ensure all content aligns with the company's brand guidelines and marketing objectives.
	Meet all content deadlines while maintaining consistency in quality and posting frequency.


Requirements


	Proven experience managing social media accounts for a business or brand.
	Proficiency in Canva, CapCut, or similar graphic design and video editing tools.
	Strong copywriting and communication skills.
	Ability to create engaging short-form video content.
	Excellent organizational and time management skills.
	Reliable internet connection and a suitable device for remote work.


Salary
N100,000 monthly.

Application Closing Date: 7th August, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Social media manager Remote" as the subject of the email. 

     

    

        Click here to Apply
